name: ChatGPT
description: OpenAI's flagship AI chatbot and coding assistant with integrated Codex agent for software development.
fullOverview: ChatGPT is OpenAI's conversational AI platform that includes the Codex coding agent for software development. Available across Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise tiers with varying model access and usage limits.
cons: Higher-tier plans are expensive
Usage limits on free tier

name: Gemini
description: Google's AI assistant with deep Google ecosystem integration and multi-modal capabilities.
fullOverview: Gemini is Google's AI assistant and coding platform, integrating with Google's ecosystem including Docs, Gmail, and the Antigravity development environment. Available in Free, Plus, Pro, and Ultra tiers.
cons: Some features locked to higher tiers
Compute-based usage limits

name: Grok
description: xAI's conversational AI with strong reasoning capabilities and voice cloning features.
fullOverview: Grok is xAI's AI assistant featuring advanced reasoning models, voice cloning, and agent capabilities. Available through free tier, SuperGrok Lite ($10/mo), SuperGrok ($30/mo), and SuperGrok Heavy ($300/mo).
cons: Higher tiers are expensive
Newer platform with evolving features

name: Claude
description: Anthropic's AI assistant with strong reasoning, coding capabilities, and the Claude Code agent.
fullOverview: Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant featuring advanced reasoning models, the Claude Code coding agent, and deep integrations with Microsoft 365. Available in Free, Pro ($20/mo), Max 5x ($100/mo), Max 20x ($200/mo), Team, and Enterprise plans.
cons: Higher tiers are expensive
Usage limits on free tier

name: Kimi
description: Moonshot AI's assistant with a massive 262K context window and multi-agent parallel processing.
fullOverview: Kimi is Moonshot AI's AI assistant with an industry-leading 262,144-token context window. Features multi-agent parallel processing with four membership tiers: Andante, Moderato, Allegretto, and Allegro.
cons: Some plans sold out
Chinese-focused platform

name: DeepSeek
description: Cost-efficient AI with 1M context window and peak/off-peak pricing.
fullOverview: DeepSeek offers affordable AI models with a 1M context window and 384K output. Features peak/off-peak pricing for cost optimization, with V4-Pro offering competitive performance at a fraction of the cost of competitors.
cons: Chinese-focused platform
Complex pricing structure

name: Perplexity AI
description: AI-powered search and research platform that provides conversational answers using web sources.
fullOverview: Perplexity AI is a research and search assistant that combines multiple AI models for comprehensive answers. Features Pro Search with advanced AI models, file uploads, and the autonomous Computer agent for complex workflows.
cons: Pro plan is expensive
Usage limits on free tier

name: Notebook LM
description: Google's research assistant that turns documents into podcasts, mind maps, and summaries.
fullOverview: Notebook LM is Google's AI research assistant that transforms documents into podcasts, mind maps, and summaries. Free tier includes 100 notebooks with 50 sources each. Paid tiers from $7.99/mo via Google AI subscriptions offer 500 notebooks and 300 sources.
cons: Paid tiers through Google AI
Limited source count

name: Microsoft Copilot
description: Everyday AI companion powered by OpenAI models integrated across Bing search, Windows, and Microsoft 365.
fullOverview: Microsoft Copilot provides real-time web-grounded reasoning, image creation via DALL-E, document synthesis, and deep productivity integration across Windows, Microsoft 365 apps, and Microsoft Edge browser.
keyFeatures: GPT-4o reasoning with Bing web search grounding
Commercial data protection for enterprise users
Voice input and interactive multimodal vision
pros: Free access to state-of-the-art OpenAI models with web search
Seamless Windows 11 and Edge browser integration
cons: Context window can feel constrained in consumer tier
Occasional interface clutter with search citations

name: Poe by Quora
description: Fast, multi-bot chat platform offering unified access to Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini, FLUX, and custom prompt bots.
fullOverview: Poe (Platform for Open Exploration) by Quora is an AI aggregator providing access to dozens of state-of-the-art models in a single interface. Users can chat with Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, Mistral Large, Llama 3, and build or monetize custom bots.
keyFeatures: Unified access to all leading frontier models
Custom prompt bot creator and monetization
Compute points system for flexible model usage
Cross-platform sync across web and mobile
pros: Compare different AI model responses side by side
Single monthly subscription covers all major AI providers
cons: Points system limits heavy daily queries on top models
Less specialized for deep multi-file software engineering

name: You.com
description: AI search engine and productivity assistant offering cited research answers, custom agents, and deep research modes.
fullOverview: You.com combines conversational AI with real-time web search indexing. It offers specialized modes like Smart, Genius (multi-step Python-driven reasoning), Research (in-depth academic synthesis), and Creative writing assistance.
keyFeatures: Multi-step Genius mode with live Python execution
Research mode with comprehensive source bibliography
Customizable privacy modes and zero ad tracking
pros: Excellent citation transparency with direct web sources
Multi-step computational reasoning in Genius mode
High commitment to privacy and ad-free searching
cons: Genius mode queries take longer to compute
Free tier has daily caps on advanced models

name: Pi by Inflection
description: Empathetic, highly conversational personal AI designed for friendly dialogue, self-reflection, and spoken guidance.
fullOverview: Pi, created by Inflection AI, is designed as a supportive, empathetic conversational companion. It stands out with natural, human-like voice synthesis, deep conversational recall within sessions, and active listening capabilities.
keyFeatures: Zero-clutter minimalist mobile and web interface
Completely free to use without subscription gates
pros: Most natural and expressive spoken voice synthesis in AI
Exceptional companion for brainstorming and talk therapy
cons: Not designed for coding or technical documentation
Does not support image generation or file attachments

name: Le Chat by Mistral
description: European frontier conversational assistant powered by Mistral Large, Pixtral vision, and Codestral reasoning.
fullOverview: Le Chat is Mistral AI's flagship conversational interface. It provides direct, cost-effective access to Mistral Large 2, Codestral for code generation, and Pixtral for multimodal document and image understanding, respecting European GDPR standards.
keyFeatures: Pixtral multimodal vision and PDF understanding
Web search grounding with cited sources
European data residency and strict GDPR compliance
pros: Very generous free tier with high speed
Top-tier multilingual fluency across French, German, Spanish
cons: Ecosystem features (e.g. plugins) still maturing
Voice input is more basic than competitors

name: HuggingChat
description: Open-source conversational AI hub letting users chat with Llama 3, Qwen, Command R+, and community fine-tunes.
fullOverview: HuggingChat is Hugging Face's open-source alternative to proprietary chatbots. It allows users to chat with the latest open-weights models including Meta Llama 3, Cohere Command R+, and Alibaba Qwen with live web search and custom assistant tools.
keyFeatures: Switch between leading open models (Llama 3, Qwen, Gemma)
Community assistant creator with system prompts
Integrated live web search via DuckDuckGo
pros: True transparency and open-source model access
Custom tools and web search integration
cons: Occasional rate limits during peak Hugging Face traffic
No native desktop app

name: Consensus
description: AI research engine that searches 200M+ academic papers and provides evidence-based answers with consensus meters.
fullOverview: Consensus extracts findings directly from peer-reviewed scientific literature. Its Consensus Meter visualizes scientific agreement on contested topics, extracts methodologies, and creates citation-backed literature reviews.
keyFeatures: Automated study metadata extraction (sample size, design)
pros: Zero hallucinations: answers come strictly from peer-reviewed papers
Essential tool for evidence-based policymaking and research
cons: Best for scientific/medical fields, less suited for tech docs
Advanced synthesis filters require premium plan

name: Elicit
description: AI research assistant that automates literature reviews, synthesizes papers, and extracts structured data from PDFs.
fullOverview: Elicit uses language models to help researchers analyze research papers at scale. It extracts custom data columns from batches of papers, synthesizes key takeaways, finds related work, and automates systematic reviews.
keyFeatures: Custom data extraction across dozens of PDFs
BIB and CSV export for reference managers
pros: Replaces weeks of manual paper reading and data entry
Extracts specific numerical variables across research studies
cons: Credit consumption system for heavy paper extraction
Focused strictly on academic literature

name: Scite.ai
description: Smart citation platform that classifies citations as supporting, mentioning, or contrasting research findings.
fullOverview: Scite.ai introduces Smart Citations, allowing researchers to see how a publication has been cited by providing the context of the citation and a classification indicating whether it provides supporting or contrasting evidence for the cited claim.
keyFeatures: Smart Citations categorizing supporting vs contrasting evidence
Scite Assistant for cited question answering
Reference check for retracted or disputed papers
Browser extension for PubMed, Google Scholar, and Nature
pros: Immediately identifies if a study has been debunked or contradicted
Browser extension shows citation validity anywhere on the web
Trusted by major academic publishers worldwide
cons: Subscription required after 7-day free trial
Specialized primarily for scientific literature

name: Phind
description: Intelligent search engine optimized specifically for developers, technical documentation, and complex coding questions.
fullOverview: Phind is an answer engine tailored for software engineers. It indexes official documentation, GitHub repositories, and Stack Overflow, providing instant answers accompanied by executable code snippets, compiler links, and technical explanations.
keyFeatures: Developer-optimized search index and technical citations
Phind-70B model fine-tuned for software engineering
VS Code extension for in-editor documentation lookups
Deep search mode with multi-link source crawling
pros: Significantly faster and more accurate for technical debugging than general chatbots
Direct links to official library documentation and GitHub issues
Generous free access with lightning-fast latency
cons: Not intended for general creative writing or marketing copy
Deep search mode consumes subscription credits

name: Writesonic
description: AI writing and SEO content platform for long-form articles, ad copy, and brand voice automation.
fullOverview: Writesonic provides generative writing tools tuned for marketing teams, copywriters, and content agencies. It includes Article Writer 6 for SEO-optimized long-form blog posts, Chatsonic for real-time web chat, and Photosonic for marketing imagery.
keyFeatures: Article Writer for 3,000+ word SEO blog posts
Brand Voice customization and tone memory
pros: Fast long-form blog drafting with keyword optimization
Built-in publishing integrations to WordPress and Ghost
cons: Generated content still requires human editorial polish
Credits expire monthly on specific plans

name: Copy.ai
description: AI copywriting and sales workflow automation platform helping marketing and GTM teams scale content.
fullOverview: Copy.ai has evolved from a simple copywriting assistant into an enterprise GTM AI platform. It connects large language models to automated workflows that generate outbound sales sequences, blog posts, social campaigns, and product collateral.
keyFeatures: Infobase for central brand guidelines and company context
Chat by Copy.ai with live web search
Team permissions and enterprise data compliance
pros: Powerful multi-step workflows for recurring marketing tasks
Excellent brand voice consistency via Infobase
Unlimited chat queries on paid plans
cons: Advanced workflow automations require paid plan
Can produce generic copy without detailed prompt tuning
